title: Unnormalized Endpoint Supports: Ni2/coronene Spin-Control Connectivity Graph benchmark
description: Version 2.0.0 of the Ni2/coronene Spin-Control Connectivity Graph benchmark archive. Adds full-grid endpoint-support accounting for G = D2 S_L S_R, permanent-dipole-difference sensitivity records, updated figures, and a fixed-orbital ten-root CAS(26,15) CI screen with inputs, starting orbitals, logs, and HDF5 outputs. The screen places at least seven additional roots below 0.65 eV at the CI level; higher-root MS-CASPT2 energies and an enlarged spin-orbit graph remain uncomputed. The archive documents state-set sensitivity in one fixed-geometry computational construction and does not establish retained-state convergence, molecular-candidate ranking performance, or predictive control fidelity.
